title: introduce-callpath-metrics-and-deferred-log-enrichment
author: Sofia Chen
description:
Motivation: production operators need a way to attribute tail latency and token-cost spikes back to the originating callsite (the application call path) rather than only per-route rollups. This PR instruments callpath-level metrics and introduces a deferred log enrichment worker that hydrates logs once trace context and invocation identifiers converge.

What this PR does: implements a lightweight callpath identifier (callpath_id) propagated end-to-end, emits callpath-scoped histograms and token-cost counters, adds an OTEL-compatible trace propagator for cross-queue handoffs, and ships a background enrichment worker that attaches trace and token attribution fields to earlier-logged events once the invocation completes. Also adds a small Grafana dashboard and a runbook note for tuning alert noise.

Design notes: callpath_id is derived deterministically from a hashed stack of callsite metadata the SDK emits (service, module, method, user_route_hint). We intentionally keep it opaque and stable across minor code moves. Metrics use a new prefix telemetry.callpath.{latency_ms,p50,p95,p99,token_cost_tokens} with labels {model,region,callpath_id,customer_tier}. The deferred enrichment worker subscribes to the invocation-complete queue; it looks up traces from the trace index and patches the original log event with token_cost and trace_id fields via an append-only enrichment store to avoid rewriting historical logs.

Rollout plan: feature gated via env var TELEMETRY_CALLPATH_ENABLED (off by default). Initial rollout to canary tenants (10 small tenants) for two weeks. If no significant increase in metrics cardinality and CI runs for enrichment show <1s median hydration, flip the flag for all hosted read-only telemetry. Private/Dedicated customers need to opt-in since the enrichment worker requires access to the trace index and S3-compatible staging.

Monitoring and alerting changes: adds a per-callpath cardinality guard metric (telemetry.callpath.cardinality_warning) and an alert that auto-suppresses on short-lived callpaths. Updates the token-cost SLO dashboard to include a callpath breakdown panel and a top-10 callpath spike breaker.

Testing: unit tests for the callpath hashing and propagation (Python and Go layers), integration test that simulates cross-queue propagation and verifies enrichment writes, and an end-to-end smoke bench that compares pre/post token_cost distributions.

Related: ENG-1987 (callpath attribution), ENG-2044 (deferred enrichment design), references to prior work on token-cost rollups (see PRs: pr-218334, pr-271456).

Checklist: [x] unit tests added, [x] integration test, [x] dashboard JSON checked in, [x] docs: observability/callpath-metrics.md, [x] feature-flag added, [x] runbook snippet in docs/runbooks/callpath_enrichment.md

Notes: kept the enrichment worker intentionally single-writer per-invocation to prevent double-enrichment races; this is captured in the worker implementation comments. Expect moderate telemetry index query load during initial rollout — infra capacity has been scoped in ENG-2090.

release_notes: Adds callpath-level telemetry and a deferred log enrichment worker to attach token-cost and trace data to earlier log events. Feature gated; opt-in for private deployments.
